title: Epigenetic heritability of cell plasticity drives cancer drug resistance through one-to-many genotype to phenotype mapping
authors: Oliveira E; Oliveira E; Milite S; Fernandez-Mateos J; Cresswell GD; Yara-Romero E; Vlachogiannis G; Chen B; James C; Patruno L; Ascolani G; Acar A; Heide T; Spiteri I; Graudenzi A; Caravagna G; Bertotti A; Graham TA; Magnani L; Valeri N; Sottoriva A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究癌症耐药中的表观遗传可塑性与克隆演化，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer drug resistance is multi-factorial, driven by heritable (epi)genetic changes but also phenotypic plasticity. Here we dissect it by perturbing colorectal cancer patient-derived organoids longitudinally with drugs in sequence. Combining longitudinal tracking, single cell ’omics, evolutionary modelling, and machine leaning, we found that different targeted drugs select for distinct subclones, supporting rationally designed drug sequences. The cellular memory was encoded as a heritable epigenetic configuration, from which multiple transcriptional programmes could run, supporting a one-to-many (epi)genotype-to- phenotype map that explains how clonal expansions and plasticity manifest together. This may ensure drug resistance subclones can exhibit distinct phenotypes in changing environments while still preserving the cellular memory encoding for their selective advantage. Chemotherapies resistance was instead entirely driven by plasticity. Inducing further chromosomal instability before drug application changed clonal evolution but not convergent transcriptional programmes. Collectively, our data show how genetic and epigenetic alterations are selected to “permissive epigenome” enabling phenotypic plasticity.
abstract_zh: 癌症药物耐药性是多因素导致的，既受遗传性（表观）遗传变化驱动，也受表型可塑性影响。在此，我们通过纵向序列性药物扰动结直肠癌患者来源的类器官来剖析这一过程。结合纵向追踪、单细胞组学、进化建模和机器学习，我们发现不同的靶向药物会选择不同的亚克隆，支持合理设计的药物序列。细胞记忆被编码为一种可遗传的表观遗传构型，从中可运行多种转录程序，支持一种一对多（表观）基因型到表型的映射，这解释了克隆扩增和可塑性如何同时显现。这可能确保耐药亚克隆在变化的环境中能表现出不同表型，同时仍保留编码其选择性优势的细胞记忆。而化疗耐药则完全由可塑性驱动。在药物应用前诱导进一步的染色体不稳定性改变了克隆进化，但并未改变趋同的转录程序。总体而言，我们的数据展示了遗传和表观遗传改变如何被选择为“允许性表观基因组”，从而实现表型可塑性。
